원자료 R00827의 적용 맥락: This paper examines whether debt mitigates agency problems in publicly listed non-financial firms across 18 emerging-market countries. It combines ownership structure measures (control vs. cash-flow rights, measured around 1995–96), firm accounting data (primarily 1990–1997) and a debt-issuance record (1980–1997) to study firms as the unit of analysis. The institutional setting emphasizes pyramid ownership, weak shareholder/creditor protection, and heterogeneous debt markets (domestic banks, syndicated term loans, Eurobonds, U.S. bonds) that differ in monitoring and disclosure.
